{{< include ../exercise-header.qmd >}}


::: {#exr-deer-put-cotton}
Give at least **five** names for units used for each of these four fundamental {{< var dim.dim >}}s. You might need to do a web search to find unfamiliar units.

Whenever one of your units came as a surprise to you, write it with double-stars around it, like `**parsec**`.

```{r echo=FALSE}
default_text <- "Length:
Mass: 
Time: 
Temperature: 
"
```

`r devoirs::devoirs_text("RQ-units-fundamental", contents = default_text, rows = 5)`

:::
 <!-- end of exr-deer-put-cotton -->
